_doc: Per-waterway pipeline config. Consumed by scripts/build_waterway_geometry.py, scripts/build_waterway.py, scripts/fetch_waterway_osm.py and the three neer-vazhvu-api/scripts/build_waterway_*.py satellite scripts. Extracted 19 Aug 2026 when the Cooum became waterway 2; every value here reproduces the Buckingham Canal build byte-for-byte (gates: verify_waterway_buckingham.py + audit_waterway_numbers.py).

geometry._doc: Chainage 0 at the Ennore end (max lat), increasing south. gap_m bridges the Basin Bridge / Cooum junction (~1.4 km) where OSM has no continuous canal way.

fetch_note: Canal OSM inputs are the manually fetched Aug 2026 snapshot (pre-generalization); refetching would move the geometry baseline, so no fetch block exists here. New waterways carry one (see cooum.json).

attribution.osm: Centerline and width measurement derived from OpenStreetMap (ODbL).
attribution.sentinel: Chips and corridor metrics contain modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026).

build.editorial_note: Editorial compilation: every fact referenced here carries its own source, date and flag in the claim register (claims.json), curated in docs/waterways/buckingham-canal/waterway-curation.json and gated by scripts/verify_waterway_buckingham.py + scripts/audit_waterway_numbers.py. Empty sources by design - per-claim citations carry accountability.
build.synthesis_source: Neer Vazhvu synthesis of the sourced dossier

notes.reaches: Measured layers (OSM transect widths, Sentinel-2 composites, Open Buildings counts) merged with curated per-reach facts; curated facts carry per-claim citations (see claims.json).
notes.today: Current-season snapshot: Sentinel-2 Jun-Aug 2026 composite metrics, Open Buildings edge counts, OSM water polygons.
notes.width_profile: 1,492 perpendicular transects every 50 m across the OSM water-surface polygons; see reaches.json confidence tiers.
notes.centerline: Chained OSM canal centerline, km 0 at the Ennore creek crossing; ~1.4 km bridged at the Basin Bridge / Cooum junction where OSM has no continuous channel.

osm-overpass.title: OpenStreetMap waterway and water-surface geometry (Overpass API)

sentinel-2-l2a.title: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance composites (Google Earth Engine)
